claim: The fact about inverting `f` is stated only after taking images under `v`, with the awkward right-hand side `(invMonoidHom ∘ v) '' baseOf v f`. The proof goes through a `suffices ∀ f` and a long chain of `image_comp` / `MonoidHom.comp_assoc` rewrites. The underlying fact is at the level of indices: `i ∈ baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f) ↔ i⁻¹ ∈ baseOf v f`.
requested_change: Add the index-level lemma `IsMulIndecomposable.inv_mem_baseOf_iff (i : ι) : i⁻¹ ∈ baseOf v f ↔ i ∈ baseOf v (invMonoidHom.comp f)` (proved by unfolding and reindexing `j ↦ j⁻¹`, `k ↦ k⁻¹`). Derive `image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq` from it by `ext x; constructor; rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨i⁻¹, ..., by simp [hv_inv]⟩`, dropping the rewrite chain.
evidence: lean_verify_edit (lines 57-77 replaced by `inv_mem_baseOf_iff` plus the re-proved `image_baseOf_inv_comp_eq`): success, no warnings, and `Subgroup.closure_image_isMulIndecomposable_baseOf` downstream still compiles. The proof of the iff is `change IsMulIndecomposable v _ i⁻¹ ↔ IsMulIndecomposable v _ i; simp only [IsMulIndecomposable, mem_setOf_eq, MonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, invMonoidHom_apply, hv_inv, map_inv, one_lt_inv']; refine and_congr_right fun _ ↦ ?_; constructor`, with each direction `intro h j hj k hk hjk; simpa [hv_inv] using h j⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) k⁻¹ (by simpa [hv_inv]) (by rw [hv_inv, hv_inv, ← mul_inv, ← hjk])` (adding `inv_inv` in the second direction).
